Mira: Heads-up — NovoCare onboarding. Customer flagged p95 text-gen ~2.3s and bursty tail. Theyre nervous about latency for chat flows. Thinking proactive steps: int8 quant on their model, swap some short prompts to a compact model, and add a latency-first routing rule for premium users. Any blockers for a canary tomorrow morning? :eyes:
Sam: Can you paste the perf snapshot + token length distribution? want to confirm whether batching or kv-cache warmup is the culprit.
Mira: Perf link: https://redwood.metrics/teams/novocare/trace-9a2b — median is fine, tail spikes around long-context sessions. Most requests are 8-40 tokens but ~6% >512.
Noah: Got it. Quick plan from ML side: 1) run int8 quant build for their current model (evals first), 2) create a compact candidate (gpt-compact-3) for <64-token calls, 3) routing policy: if route=customer_premium and expected_tokens<64 -> compact; else latency-first fallback to dedicated pool. Canary 5% traffic.
Noah: Example routing rule snippet: ```json
{
  "condition": "customer == \"novocare\" && expected_tokens < 64",
  "action": "route: gpt-compact-3@canary"
}
```
Tina: I can request a 2hr maintenance/canary window with the customer tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT. They prefer low-risk changes first. Please confirm the canary CLI so I can include it.
Sam: Canary deploy CLI (use with care):
```
redwood deploy canary --model gpt-compact-3 --customer novocare --pct 5 --monitor regression_rate,latency_p95 --rollback-on regression_rate>0.5
```
DeployBot: Canary job started by Sam at 6161616180 — monitoring hooks active. Alerts will post to #incidents if thresholds breached.
Jules: Also add a short eval set to capture semantic drift for 48h and tie to renewal health dashboard. If regression_rate > 0.3 for 24h, flag CS owner for renewal outreach.
Mira: Perfect. Action items: Noah to push quant build + compact canary, Sam to run canary command at start window, Tina to confirm customer window, Jules to wire change into renewal health dashboard. Ill update onboarding ticket and ping for post-canary sync. :thumbsup:
